item.title: Rescheduled RPI Food Forum 10/14
item.description: Student Culinary Council is now RPI Food Forum! Join Rensselaer Dining leadership for a group discussion and provide feedback on your dining experience at our updated date and time! item.title: Program Spotlight: Systems Engineering & Mechanical Engineering with RPI at Work
item.description: Date: Thursday, October 15, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:30 PM - Join RPI at Work Associate Dean Michael Hughes for a 30-minute information session covering RPI’s online, project-based Master of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering and Master of Engineering in Systems Engineering degree programs. Explore how professionals can develop their practice in core engineering disciplines while being able to customize the program to fit their needs. Please register to attend.

item.title: Reminder for Faculty: NSF GRFP Letters of Recommendation due Oct. 16th
item.description: Letters of recommendation for students applying to the NSF GRFP are due October 16th, days BEFORE the students applications are due. Students will not be able to submit their applications if your recommendations are not entered by the deadline. Encourage your students to seek a review from Betty Madigan prior to submitting their applications: formatting requirements have changed! Faculty may also request feedback on their recommendation letters. Send any drafts or questions to madige@rpi.edu.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Call for Survey Participants - First Generation Faculty & Staff
item.description: As we prepare for our National First-Generation Student week November 3-7, the Office of Inclusive Excellence invites you to complete this short survey if you are a faculty or staff member who identifies—or has identified—as a first-generation college graduate- (defined as someone whose parent(s)/guardian(s) did not complete a four-year college degree).
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: RPI Faculty In-Person Workshop - Designing Assignments with AI in Mind
item.description:
Date: Tuesday, October 27, 2026 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM - This one-hour introductory session will provide practical ideas for adapting assignments while keeping learning at the center. We will explore examples from a variety of disciplines, discuss different approaches to student AI use, and share simple strategies that can help instructors rethink assignments without starting from scratch. Please click the link in the See section to register by Friday, October 23rd. Space is limited.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
